message:
Run H2 native requests outside Tokio and observe cold recovery

Keep each synchronous H2 Service call in a scoped OS thread joined by its existing Tokio blocking worker. Preserve the original absolute deadline, connection capacity and native runtime guard.

Add fixed normal-build timing stages around the existing cold recovery operations, retaining their results and repair fallback. Include focused worker and timing tests, preserve the reviewed CI fixes, and carry the exact 3cb fresh-ingress observations.

This candidate has passed pinned formatting and source review only. Mac and Linux compilation, selected regressions, real TLS/native snapshot and multi-host qualification remain required.
